g.text: Transposing the clustering more than doubles it

path.style: stroke: #0b0b0b; stroke-width: 2.175

text.style: font-size: 21.75px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Clustering parameters by tokens, instead of tokens by parameters

text.style: font-size: 13.92px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: The attribution matrix is [N tokens × D weight coordinates]. The production fit clusters its ROWS — tokens that use similar parameters — and

text.style: font-size: 13.92px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: derives weight ownership from that. The transpose clusters its COLUMNS: parameters used by similar tokens. Crossed with whether magnitude

text.style: font-size: 13.92px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: survives normalisation, that gives four arms, each run through the full pipeline (GIM features → k-means → softpart bank → ablation) at C=256

text.style: font-size: 13.92px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: on a 8k-position pilot, three seeds. The transposed k-means costs 0.1–0.5 s, cheaper than the row k-means it replaces; the bank build dominates at ~40 s.
